description: This file implements a custom optional class similar to std::experimental::optional, providing optional value semantics with support for nullopt and in-place construction, including class and method definitions, operator overloads, and internal implementation details.

classes.name: optional
classes.description: A template class providing optional value semantics, including constructors, assignment operators, dereference operators, and comparison operators.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Conversion operator to check if the optional is engaged.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns a reference to the contained value, with debug check for engagement.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two optional objects.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Internal method to construct the contained object in place.

methods.name: EnsureDisengaged
methods.description: Internal method to destruct the contained object and mark as disengaged.
